note: Field-level scoring: partial credit per field, case passes only if all fields match.
not_verified: Field values are matched by case-insensitive exact string (category) or exact equality (recurring boolean). It does not check that 'category' is the most specific correct label from a real taxonomy — a plausible synonym or a coarser-but-defensible category counts as wrong with no credit for being close — and it cannot detect a case where the correct category is genuinely ambiguous from the transaction line alone.
